newsitem.title: GREECE: Turkish warplane crashes near Greek island.
newsitem.headline: Turkish warplane crashes near Greek island.

text.p: A Turkish fighter plane crashed near the Greek island of Chios in the eastern Aegean on Tuesday and the fate of the pilot was unknown, Greek television channels said.

Quoting defence ministry officials, they said the crash came on the last day of joint Greek-Cypriot military exercises near the island of Rhodes. Greece has charged that numerous airspace violations by Turkish planes have occurred during the exercises.
Greek and Cypriot forces have combined exercises - one called Nikiforos on Cyprus and a separate exercise, Toxotis, in the southern Aegean.
The exercises come under a 1993 joint military agreement between Greece and the militarily divided island of Cyprus.

Greece reported more than 50 airspace violations on Monday, when the exercises started. Greek fighter planes were scrambled more than 40 times to intercept Turkish planes on Monday, the defence ministry said.
